text:
emma nguyen: @here quick heads-up — we pushed a minor pricebook patch tonight: Ratecard v5.1 is live in staging and will go to prod Thu 09:00 PT. This is a patch release (no change to commit math), primary changes are: 1) embeddings unit pricing down 6% for large-volume tiers, 2) reserved GPU burst add-on clarified (new SKU), 3) small doc clarifications on discount stack order. :information_source:

jack sullivan: do we have a clear rule on which active commits get grandfathered? some customers on 12-month commits asked this morning.

emma nguyen: short answer — all active signed commits keep their effective unit price (grandfathered) unless they explicitly opt into the new ratecard. v5.1 is a patch by our semver policy: patch = doc/clarity/discount adjustments that don’t change commit calculations. I logged the canonical language in the internal pricing runbook.

maria ribeiro: thanks. where can I see a list of opportunities that would see a delta if they opt in (to communicate to AE/CS)?

emma nguyen: good ask. use this SOQL against the pricebook snapshot table in SFDC:

```
SELECT Id, Name, AccountId, Commit_Start__c, Commit_Tier__c, Applied_Ratecard__c
FROM Opportunity
WHERE Applied_Ratecard__c IN ('v5.0','v5.0-legacy')
AND Commit_Tier__c IS NOT NULL
```

That gives candidates. For delta calc we have a small report job: /tools/pricing/delta-report --ratecard v5.1 --since 2025-01-01. Ping me if you don't have access.

noah chen: APAC ops — will this push require a separate pricebook import for the ap-southeast-1 pricebook? last time regional pricebooks were separate files.

emma nguyen: yes — we sync regional pricebooks from the canonical pricebook export. Release-bot will create the artifact and place it in S3 under s3://redwood-release/pricebooks/v5.1/. The APAC team needs to run the import script:

```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-release/pricebooks/v5.1/apac.csv ./apac.csv
python infra/scripts/import_pricebook.py --region ap-southeast-1 --file apac.csv
```

I added a note to the runbook for the import window (Thu 09:00–09:15 PT).

lina gomez: deal desk question — for discounts that stack with committed tiers (e.g., EDU/promo credits) does v5.1 change precedence? a few deals pending approval today.

emma nguyen: no precedence change. We clarified precedence text only (so it’s more explicit): 1) committed tier base price, 2) promo/partner discounts (multiplicative), 3) limited-time credits applied last. If a special term changes the math, that triggers a minor bump (not this patch).

jack sullivan: perfect. If someone wants to opt into v5.1 mid-commit (customer asks to get lower embeddings price), what's the ops flow? do they need signed amendment?

maria ribeiro: usually we do a simple amendment that references the same commit ID and the new ratecard effective date. Legal review is only required if there’s a term change (e.g., length, termination).

emma nguyen: yep — amendment + SFDC pricebook update. Deal desk approves the amendment. I also added a short amendment template to the release artifacts.

release-bot: Deploy note: ratecard v5.1 artifacts created by release pipeline #rp-4021. Artifacts: pricebook-canonical-v5.1.csv, apac.csv, eu.csv, amendment-template-v5.1.md. Tag: release/v5.1.

noah chen: will we notify quote-ops to regen any auto quotes that reference pricebook v5.0?

emma nguyen: Quote-ops will run a compatibility script that flags quotes referencing v5.0; regen is manual for quotes in progress. I've scheduled a short sync w/quote-ops at 11:00 PT to confirm.

lina gomez: ok thank you — i'll brief deal-desk reviewers at 10:30. can we get a one-sentence summary for the reviewers?

emma nguyen: sure — one-sentence for reviewers: "Ratecard v5.1 (patch) clarifies discount precedence and adds a reserved-GPU burst SKU; it lowers embeddings unit price for high-volume tiers; active signed commits remain grandfathered unless customer signs an amendment."

jack sullivan: tagging @maria ribeiro for the amendment template link (so AEs can send it out).

maria ribeiro: got it. sharing in #sales-docs after the sync. :thumbsup:

emma nguyen: thanks everyone — please flag any active POCs or deals that need a prioritized amendment and I’ll loop in legal/deal-desk.
